title: Feed fanout decision
description:
Design a social feed for mostly small accounts plus a few celebrities. Compare fanout-on-write and fanout-on-read, describe a hybrid threshold, pagination, and freshness.

Write a structured explanation. This is a transparent keyword rubric, not an AI architect or proof of a sound design. Check every tradeoff yourself; a rubric pass demonstrates coverage only.

reference.text:
Design a social feed for mostly small accounts plus a few celebrities. Compare fanout-on-write and fanout-on-read, describe a hybrid threshold, pagination, and freshness.
Precomputing every celebrity post for millions of readers is costly. A hybrid can materialize ordinary feeds and merge celebrity posts at read time.
